name: Flex
description: Flex is a polymorphic layout primitive built on Box that uses flexbox under the hood. It handles direction, wrapping, alignment, and gaps (with per-axis overrides), and supports responsive values for a clean, mobile-first flow.

props.name: direction
props.description: Main axis direction (row, column, etc.), supports responsive values

props.name: wrap
props.description: How flex items wrap onto multiple lines, supports responsive values

props.name: justify
props.description: Distribution of items along the main axis, supports responsive values

props.name: align
props.description: Alignment of items along the cross axis, supports responsive values

props.name: gap
props.description: Shorthand spacing between items, supports responsive values

props.name: rowGap
props.description: Vertical spacing between rows, overrides gap on block axis

props.name: columnGap
props.description: Horizontal spacing between columns, overrides gap on inline axis
